verdict.rationale: Graphite Agent automatically reviews every PR, identifying potential issues and catching bugs (the functional-bug half of the story). Custom rules let teams define explicit review guidelines, which could plausibly be used to steer it toward security patterns, but no evidence says reviews detect security issues. Missing for 10: any documented detection of injection risks, leaked secrets or insecure patterns, security-specific review rules or examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of security findings.
